With today's new release, users of the SmartGym iPhone app will find it easier to adjust and log their sets during workouts, as detailed below.

SmartGym makes it easier to adjust and log your sets during a workout

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has always let users quickly adjust reps and weights when logging each set.

With this update, that flexibility now comes to the iPhone app. Users can switch freely between the original logging interface and a brand-new "Live Logging" interface, which lets you adjust values, log sets, and add new sets without ever leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small marker in the bottom-right corner of the rep and weight fields, showing the original default value for each set.

After logging a set, SmartGym also launches the rest timer right on the same screen, so you can keep training without switching views.

Here's what SmartGym looks like:

What makes this important is that SmartGym doesn't just track what you actually did — it helps you understand what you should be doing.

This update also introduces a keyboard redesigned from the ground up, making the logging process smoother during workouts. The keyboard includes buttons that let users quickly increase or decrease values, or switch between regular sets, warm-up sets, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is a second you can spend focused on your training."

Finally, this update also includes a redesigned "Smart Action Button" that predicts the most likely next action a user wants to take, and displays the corresponding action options at the bottom of the interface based on where the user is in their workout.

Options include "Log Set & Rest," "Start Exercise," "First Superset," "Update Set," "Next Exercise," and "Finish Workout," among others.

SmartGym says they've also strengthened the smarts behind the Smart Action Button:

The result is a feature that feels more natural and fluid. SmartGym quietly handles all the complexity in the background, and users only see exactly what they need, when they need it.

Worth mentioning last: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button, letting you manage your training more quickly without toggling back and forth inside the app.

SmartGym is available as a free download on the App Store, with several subscription plans offered.
